narr: Showers and thunderstorms produced widespread heavy rainfall across portions of northeastern Oklahoma during the early morning hours of the 24th, as they moved repeatedly across some of the same areas for a number of hours. Three to six inches of rain fell across northern Creek County, where flash flooding occurred.
ev: Portions of roads in and around Oilton were flooded, and a home in Oilton was threatened by flood water.
lsr: FLOODED YARD AND DRIVEWAY IN OILTON, WITH WATER VERY CLOSE TO A HOME.
